🔬 **Aflatoxin Control — Our Quality Standard**

Aflatoxin is the **#1 concern** for global peanut imports. Here's how we manage it:

**Our Process:**
1️⃣ Source only from **registered pest-compliant farmers** in high-quality clay soil regions
2️⃣ Post-harvest storage in **dry, humidity-monitored warehouse facilities**
3️⃣ **Random laboratory sampling** before shipment preparation
4️⃣ **Independent third-party inspection** (SGS / Geo-Chem) at the port

📊 **Our Standards:**
| Grade | Aflatoxin Level |
|-------|----------------|
| Java Peanut (Premium) | 4 PPB Max ✅ (EU compliant) |
| Bold Peanut (Premium) | 4 PPB Max ✅ |
| Bold Peanut (Standard) | 10 PPB ✅ |

🌍 **EU Regulation:** Maximum 4 PPB total aflatoxin for groundnuts (Reg. 2023/915)

We provide **full lab reports** with every shipment for complete transparency!

💧 **Moisture Control During Ocean Transit**

We deploy a **multi-stage moisture protection system:**

🔒 **Stage 1 — Pre-Loading Dryness Check:**
• Peanuts: Loaded only at **<8% moisture**
• Rice: Loaded only at **<14% moisture**
• Lab-verified before container sealing

🛡️ **Stage 2 — Container Protection:**
• Premium **silica gel desiccant absorber pads** placed inside each container
• **Heavy kraft cargo inner-lining paper** to isolate commodity from container walls
• Fully isolates goods from oceanic condensation and humidity spikes

📦 **Stage 3 — Packaging Barrier:**
• Multi-layer PP bags with inner HDPE lining (for rice)
• Vacuum sealed packs available for specialty peanut orders

✅ **Result:** Zero moisture-related claims across all our shipments

These protections ensure your cargo arrives in **perfect condition** at any global port!
